# Standards & federation

Integriq declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `integriq.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [VNG Objecten API](https://github.com/maykinmedia/objects-api) | 2 | Token, no login | `/apps/integriq/api/v2/objects` |
| [VNG Objecttypen API](https://github.com/maykinmedia/objecttypes-api) | 2 | Token, no login | `/apps/integriq/api/v2/objecttypes` |
| DSO-LV STAM koppelvlak (verzoeken receiver) | — | Token, no login | `/apps/integriq/api/dso/stam/verzoeken` |
| StUF-ZKN kennisgevingen receiver (zakLk01) | 3.10 | Token, no login | `/apps/integriq/api/stuf-zkn/inbound` |
| [LTI 1.3 / LTI Advantage (tool and platform, AGS, NRPS)](https://www.imsglobal.org/spec/lti/v1p3/) | 1.3 | Token, no login | `/apps/integriq/api/lti` |
| [OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance (pre-authorized code; jwt_vc_json, dc+sd-jwt)](https://openid.net/specs/openid-4-verifiable-credential-issuance-1_0.html) | — | Public | `/apps/integriq/.well-known/openid-credential-issuer` |
| [CloudEvents (HTTP binding) event publication](https://github.com/cloudevents/spec) | — | Nextcloud login | — |

## Standards this app uses

These are standards the app acts as a client of. They tell another server what this app can connect *to*.

| Standard | Version |
|---|---|
| StUF-ZKN client (outbound kennisgevingen and documents) | 3.10 |
| [ZGW Notificaties API subscriber (abonnementen + callback)](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/notificaties/) | — |
| [ZGW Zaken API client (case-system mapping)](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/zaken/) | — |
| [ZGW Documenten API client (case-system mapping)](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/documenten/) | — |
| [Peppol via an external Access Point (send, SMP lookup, inbound callback)](https://docs.peppol.eu/) | — |
| Federatieve Service Connectiviteit (FSC) client | — |
| VNG Klantinteracties API client | — |
| Edukoppeling (WUS) clients: DUO ROD, DUO Verzuimloket | — |
| Overstapservice Onderwijs (OSO) client | — |
| UWLR / Edu-V exchange client | — |
| PDOK Locatieserver geocoding client | 3.1 |

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

Integriq registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["integriq"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `integriq` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
